strongest_counterexample: A continuous donor garment can still fit the new shoulder badly, shrinkwrap can imprint musculature or bridge the wrong surface, and native finger axes may still produce a bad grasp. Actual visible evidence, not count of passed tests or prior neutral qualification, decides this candidate.
